subject: BlueFin compliance playbook & agreed next steps (SOC 2, audit logs, DPA, pen test)
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Michael Lang <m.lang@paymentscorp.io>, audits@bluefinpayments.com
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: BlueFin compliance playbook & agreed next steps (SOC 2, audit logs, DPA, pen test)

Hi Michael / BlueFin team —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap while it's fresh and a proposed playbook so we have owners and deadlines. High-level pain we heard:

- Primary need: SOC 2 attestation and demonstrable audit log retention for transaction metadata (90d primary, 7 years long-term for regulated buckets).
- Secondary: DPA redlines and clarity on data residency for settled transaction logs.
- Risk driver: procurement requires pen test report + evidence of logging and access controls before signing the MPA.

What we agreed on the call:

1) Redwood will share a short SOC 2 extract showing scope and controls (not full report) and an audit-log sample demonstrating retention/rotation.
2) We'll provide a DPA draft with redlines to start legal review.
3) Pen-test summary: share executive summary now; full report will require an NDA from your side (standard).
4) Proposed SOW items: production rollout plan + a limited retention tier mapping for your regulated flows (we sketched out 90d vs 7y buckets).

Owners & next steps (timeline):
- Tessa (Redwood): SOC 2 extract + audit-log sample by Wed 10/21 EOD. [Attachment: SOC2-summary.pdf, audit-log-sample.csv]
- Aditya (Redwood infra): short note on how audit logs are stored, KMS integration, and available retention policy options by Fri 10/23.
- BlueFin procurement (Michael): confirm who on your legal team should receive DPA redline and whether we should route DocuSign to procurement@bluefinpayments.com.
- BlueFin security: advise if an NDA is needed to receive the pen-test report (we can send executive summary w/o NDA).

Blocked items from our side: final account-scoped retention SLA and whether BlueFin will require on-prem/eventual VPC deployment for longer retention buckets.

I'll attach the initial artifacts we discussed. If anything below is incorrect, flag it and we can update. Happy to schedule a follow-up next week to walk legal/security through the artifacts (30–45m).

Thanks,

Tessa Morgan
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[t] +1 (415) 555-0219 | tessa.morgan@redwood.com
[Attachment: SOC2-summary.pdf (pdf, 860 KB); audit-log-sample.csv (csv, 220 KB); DPA-redline-v1.docx (docx, 48 KB)]

From: Michael Lang <m.lang@paymentscorp.io>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, audits@bluefinpayments.com
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BlueFin compliance playbook & agreed next steps (SOC 2, audit logs, DPA, pen test)

Tessa —

Appreciate the clear recap. Quick notes from BlueFin:

- Procurement: yes, please route DPA redlines to legal@bluefinpayments.com and cc procurement@bluefinpayments.com. We'll aim to have an initial read by 10/27.
- Security: NDA is required for the full pen-test. The executive summary is fine to share without it. Please send the exec summary to security@finpayco.com.
- Audit logs: the sample looks like the right format. We'll validate the fields (transaction_id, user_id, timestamp, action, routing_node) with our ops team and revert.

Two asks: could you also include the specific SOC 2 control IDs (CC, CR, etc.) that map to logging and change control? That helps our audit team crosswalk faster.

We are reviewing budgets this quarter — I will flag this to procurement and ask for any required PO template.

Best,
Michael Lang
Director, Payments Ops | BlueFin Payments
m.lang@paymentscorp.io
[Attachment: none]

Michael — thanks for the quick turn. Attached is the SOC 2 extract with the control IDs called out and the pen-test executive summary. I also included a short mapping table in the SOC2 extract that ties logging/change-management controls to the fields in the audit-log sample.

Actionables I drove based on your asks:
- SOC 2 control IDs: included in SOC2-summary.pdf (see section 2).
- Pen-test executive summary: pen-test-executive-summary.pdf attached. Full report available upon NDA.
- DPA redline: DPA-redline-v1.docx attached; routing per your note to legal@bluefinpayments.com & procurement@bluefinpayments.com.
- Infra note (Aditya): will follow with a short write-up on retention tiers and KMS by 10/23.

Next suggested touchpoint: 30-minute sync week of 10/26 to walk BlueFin legal/security through the artifacts and confirm any final evidence they need for procurement sign-off. If that works, Michael — can you propose two windows?

Thanks,

Tessa Morgan
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 21 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: BlueFin ask / pricing considerations

Team — quick internal note to capture commercial considerations before the 10/26 sync. Do not forward external until we align with Sales.

Summary of ask: BlueFin needs SOC 2 mapping, audit log evidence, DPA redlines, and pen-test exec summary. Procurement will likely request PO/terms and may push for a 12-month commit with retention guarantees for regulated data.

Proposed internal play:
- Offer a limited retention guarantee for the 90-day tier in contract; include optional add-on for long-term retention (7y) with separate pricing (storage + compliance ops).
- Keep pen-test full report gated behind NDA; provide the exec summary to expedite procurement.
- Pricing levers: model selection (smaller model for non-PII workloads), batching/caching settings for audit-heavy flows.

Neha — please draft a short pricing note and suggested SOW language by EOD 10/22 so we can present base and long-term options at the 10/26 customer walkthrough. Aditya — confirm technical feasibility of offering the 7y retention as a managed tier (snapshots + cold storage) by 10/23.

Markus Klein
VP, Solutions & GTM | Redwood Inference
[Internal-only]
